utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, book club? I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the plan for this week?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re meeting Thursday at 7, same place as usual. I’ll bring the notes and we can go over the chapters one by one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Thursday at 7 works for me. I’ll swing by and bring some snacks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re reading a mystery novel this month.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh nice, I’m in—what’s the title?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the book club is still meeting on Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the time and place first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s confirm it before we show up. Do you want to check the details and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I meant to bring my notes, but I forgot them again. Are we talking about the next meeting or the book we picked?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re talking about the next meeting — I’ve got the date and snack list if you want me to fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please — I’d love the date and snack list, and I’ll try not to forget it this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club meeting you mean, and what details you want me to check?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I mean the one next Thursday evening. Could you check the time and whether we’re meeting at the library?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the Thursday evening book club time and confirm whether it’s at the library.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not at all — we were just about to pick one. Any genre you’re in the mood for?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in the mood for something suspenseful, if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — what’s up with the book club?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare folding chair and a couple of pitchers if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Gus — thanks for offering. I’ll let the group know and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m happy to help with book club—where are we meeting this time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s meet at the library after school on Thursday. I’ll send out the details to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, the library after school on Thursday works for me. Thanks for sending the details out!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking the next read tonight—apparently something everyone will argue about for at least ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, then we definitely need to be there—I’ll spread the word and see who’s coming!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect—if you hear anything before I do, give me the scoop. I’m curious whether they go for a cozy mystery or something more dramatic.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we picking the next book tonight?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think so—I'm happy to hear everyone's ideas and go with the group.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what kinds of books should we put on the list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think I’ll bring the tea and we can pick the next book together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely—thanks for bringing the tea. I’d be happy to help pick the next book together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll bring the tea and we can choose the next book together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, great to see you—have you had a chance to think about which book club picks might work for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa — I’m still thinking it over, but I’d lean toward something gentle and easy to discuss this time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — a gentle, easy-to-talk-about pick sounds perfect. I’ll come up with a few options and see what feels best for the group.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new read soon—sounds like it might be a good one. Have you heard what they’re leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard yet, but I’d like to know soon so I can get it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Same here—I’m hoping they decide quickly so I can put it on my calendar too. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we were just picking the book, and I can fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — what did you all choose?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m mostly listening this week, but I’d love to hear what book the club picked.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We picked a short mystery this time — I can bring it by if you want to see it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks — I’d love to take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the book and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at my place on Maple Street next Thursday at 7. I’ll text you the title as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — just text me the title when you have it. I’ll be there next Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, book club sounds fun—what are you all reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the list before I say for sure, but I think we’re choosing between a couple of titles. I’ll tell you as soon as I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush—just let me know when you’ve got it. I’m happy to join whichever one the group picks!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—book club, right? I think I’m free, but I might’ve missed the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — I can send you the latest details and make sure you’re in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — that’d help a lot. I probably missed the update, so please send it when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, did the book club pick the next read yet? I can grab a copy while I’m out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as they do. Thanks for offering to grab a copy!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—just send me the title when you know it, and I’ll pick it up on my next errand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you help pick the next book and send a quick reminder to the group?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help pick the next book and send a quick reminder to the group.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the time and where we’re meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what works better for you, Tuesday evening at my place or the library on Oak Street?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: The library on Oak Street works better for me, but what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect—you should come to book club this week. I’ll send you the details right away!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—send me the details and I’ll check what I need to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll text you the time and address now. We’d love to have you join us!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Book club sounds lovely — I just need to make sure it doesn’t clash with the kids’ school schedule. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I was thinking Thursday evening, around 7. If that clashes, I’m happy to find another time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 should work for me as long as I can get the kids settled first. If you want, we can keep that and I’ll confirm once I check the school calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Nell — I can put the book club details together and share them with everyone on the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thank you, Rosa — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out for the details and pass them along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Nell — I’ll send out a tidy note with the time, place, and book choice soon.
